topology_reasoning: The target is a symmetric two-waveguide directional/adiabatic coupler. Two constant-width material rails enter from the left with a large vertical separation, bend smoothly toward one another, run closest together around the center, and separate symmetrically toward the right. The black material is layer (1,0), and the device is horizontally oriented across an 18 um by 3 um calibrated footprint. Function-defining knobs are wg_width (rail width), min_gap (closest edge-to-edge spacing), interaction_length (central near-parallel coupling length), and transition_length (each smooth approach/departure length). The topology is assembled from parametric waveguide paths and an @gf.cell, with no pre-built device stencil or raw polygon emission.
